_instructions: Copy this file to workspace/[task-id]/changes/changes.json and fill in the values. Delete this _instructions field when done.

_field_guide.goal: One sentence: what was the overall goal of these changes
_field_guide.summary.lines_added: Total lines added across all files
_field_guide.summary.lines_removed: Total lines removed across all files
_field_guide.summary.agents: List of agent names that contributed (e.g., workflow-agent). Use 'orchestrator' if no agent was spawned
_field_guide.files[].path: Relative file path from project root
_field_guide.files[].summary: One sentence: what changed in this file and why
_field_guide.files[].hunks[].header: The @@ line range @@ from the diff
_field_guide.files[].hunks[].old_code: Removed lines (without the - prefix). Empty string if addition only
_field_guide.files[].hunks[].new_code: Added lines (without the + prefix). Empty string if deletion only
_field_guide.files[].hunks[].explanation: 1 to 2 sentences: what this change does and why it matters. Concise, non-formal, professional, no dashes
